name: EXO
summary: EXO-200 was a liquid-xenon time projection chamber at the Waste Isolation Pilot Plant. It measured xenon-136 two-neutrino decay and searched for the neutrinoless mode, providing the experimental foundation for the larger nEXO proposal.
detection_principle: Ionization and scintillation jointly reconstruct energy and three-dimensional event positions. The anticorrelation of charge and light improves energy resolution; topology separates single-site double-beta events from many gamma backgrounds.

results.summary: The full dataset produced a 90% confidence lower half-life limit of 3.5 x 10^25 yr.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
